name: imgradientxyz
expr: [Gx, Gy, Gz] = imgradientxyz(V); [Gxp, Gyp, Gzp] = imgradientxyz(V, 'prewitt'); [Gxc, Gyc, Gzc] = imgradientxyz(V, 'central'); [Gxi, Gyi, Gzi] = imgradientxyz(V, 'intermediate'); r1 = Gx(2,2,2); r2 = Gy(2,2,2); r3 = Gz(2,2,2); r4 = Gx(1,1,1); r5 = Gz(3,4,5); r6 = Gxp(2,2,2); r7 = Gyp(2,2,2); r8 = Gzp(2,2,2); r9 = Gxc(2,2,2); r10 = Gzc(2,2,2); r11 = Gxi(2,2,2); r12 = Gxi(3,4,5);
comment: Sig: [Gx,Gy,Gz] = imgradientxyz(V,method). Branches: sobel (3x3x3 [1,3,3,1]-weighted MATLAB R2025b kernel), prewitt, central (gradient()), intermediate (forward diff). Replicate boundary. Image namespace 2026-05-27.
